description.value: Timbertrain Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver-based specialty roaster founded in 2011, with The Depot being their Grandview-Woodlands location in East Vancouver. The café roasts its own beans, sourcing from farms across multiple origins, and serves as both a sit-in café and a local pickup point for online coffee orders. With a focus on relationship-driven sourcing and community, it offers a considered, independent alternative to chain coffee stops on a tour through East Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website contact page explicitly identifies 'Grandview-Woodlands – The Depot' at 551 McLean Dr, Vancouver, BC V5L 0C2 with phone (236) 339-7881, matching the OSM Depot record. The site confirms the location is open and operating as both a cafe and a local pickup point for online orders. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike rack, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM record carries no address or phone; both were sourced from the website contact page and should be verified against the OSM record.

Website is in transition — the business is migrating to timbertrain.ca for new orders, but the current site (timbertraincoffeeroasters.com) remains live. The new URL may be worth adding once confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active specialty coffee café in East Vancouver with a confirmed physical address and operating hours. Useful stop for touring cyclists passing through Grandview-Woodlands.
